note.zh: 本帝国自己的顾问 VIR 弹出，询问是否重新开启（或关闭）新手指引；选项会实际改变教程等级。825、830 与科学家归来 840 都以此收尾。
note.en: The empire's own advisor VIR pops up asking to re-enable (or shut down) guidance; the options really change the tutorial level. 825, 830 and the scientist's return 840 all end here.

notes.zh: 科学家被机器的“建议”迷住而留下，探索结束、科学家被放逐；1800 天后经隐藏事件 835 归来（840），获得“裂隙扭曲”及天才/严谨/漫游者之一的特质。
notes.en: Enthralled by the machine's “advice”, the scientist stays behind: the exploration ends and the scientist is exiled; 1800 days later, via hidden event 835, they return (840) with Rift Warped and one of Spark of Genius / Meticulous / Roamer.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 800–845 全部事件，包括 815 的放逐与 1800 天后的归来、三条路线共同的 VIR 收尾。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 800–845, including the exile in 815 with the return after 1800 days and the shared VIR coda of all three routes.
